## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Evidence

List the commands or calculations actually checked and the data snapshot used.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused purpose and appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Frozen source records remain unchanged, or a versioned correction is documented.
- [ ] Units, comparison objectives and source provenance remain explicit.
- [ ] Claims follow the available evidence, including negative or inconclusive results.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and licence notices are retained.
